description: Dati trasporto pubblico urbano ATM (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Messina. Dati del trasporto pubblico urbano in formato GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification). Principali informazioni disponibili: anagrafica delle fermate (georeferenziate), elenco delle linee, elenco delle corse, elenco degli orari di arrivo e partenza. Coverage: Comune di Messina. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Messina. Its tags are autobus, bus, estivi, gtfs, invernali. It offers 5 resource(s) in GTFS. The portal shows 2026-04-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
